# three.js 0.187.0

Copied unchanged from the npm package `three@0.187.0` (https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.187.0.tgz), keeping its folder layout. Only the files mock-up B uses.

- three.js: MIT, `LICENSE`.
- Draco decoder (`examples/jsm/libs/draco/gltf/`): Apache-2.0, `examples/jsm/libs/draco/LICENSE` (from github.com/google/draco). Only the WebAssembly build; the asm.js fallback (`draco_decoder.js`) is left out.
